description: Turn a text prompt into a 1024x1024 JPEG in about four seconds. Text-to-image generation pay-per-call, no account and no API key: send a prompt, receive a 1024x1024 JPEG as a base64 data URL in about four seconds (FLUX.1 schnell). Photorealistic scenes, illustrations, product shots, thumbnails and social visuals. Optional seed for reproducible output. Several times cheaper than other image routes on x402. Body: {prompt, seed?} — $0.020000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "generate an image of a cat", "text to image", "create a picture of a sunset".
name: image
